description: Digest-pins the Docker base images and the GitHub Actions. The Debian base image updates itself (digest, minor and patch) once the build check passes; a new Debian release (major) and every action update wait for a manual merge.

packageRules.description: Debian base image: security fixes arrive as digest updates of trixie-slim
A new Debian release (trixie to forky) changes the library package names of the runtime stage
